metadata.description: MCP server for MyAtriumHealth (Atrium Health's Epic MyChart patient portal) — test results, medications, allergies, immunizations, health issues, visits and messages. Requests relay through the user's own signed-in browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension, reusing their existing session.

plugins.name: myatriumhealth-mcp
